sentences.text: This third application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail has been filed by the accused/applicant who has been arrested in connection with Crime No.40/2023 registered at Police Station Devendra Nagar, Raipur for the offence under Section 376, 376 (2) (n) & 506 of the IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
2. Prosecution case, in short, is that the accused/applicant threatened the prosecutrix of dire consequences and committed rape with her several times.

It is pertinent to mention here that earlier bail application filed by the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 26.07.2023 passed in MCRC No.5257/2023.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the accused/applicant is innocent and has been roped in a false case.
He further submits that the prosecutrix has been examined and she has not supported the case of the prosecution.

He also submits that the applicant is languishing in jail since Mohammad Irfan Khan @ Imran Khan @ Happu vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135609790/
1 25.03.2023 and conclusion of the trial is likely Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:19213 to take some more time, therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.
4.

entities.text: Mohammad Irfan Khan @ Imran Khan @ Happu vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Per contra, learned State counsel vehemently opposes the prayer for bail and submits that first bail application of the applicant was rejected on merits vide order dated 22.06.2023 passed in MCRC No.3827/2023 and there is no change in the facts or circumstances of the case, therefore,
present is not a fit case for grant of bail.

5. Having regard to the aforesaid submissions and keeping in mind the fact that earlier bail application was rejected on merits and so far there is no material change in the circumstances of the case further considering the gravity of offence and the victim's statement, I do not find present to be a fit case for grant of bail.

Sd/-
(Deepak Kumar Tiwari) Judge Ajay Mohammad Irfan Khan @ Imran Khan @ Happu vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135609790/
